title: RFC-1 (GH issue 2) compatibility review: check open work (271/272/273/275/280) + recent arcs against the Thermite 2 design

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Result: full compatibility review of RFC-1 + stage-2 metatheory + program plan + Appendix A (all baselined at 93d3cbc0, predating our entire #257-#281 run). VERDICTS: #275/#280 no conflict (bug fixes to machinery the RFC keeps verbatim — 'the cage battery is Thermite 1's, unchanged'; pre-M1 debt in spirit). #271 no conflict (additive report-only cert field; coordinate with stage-1 schema-v2 work). #273 no conflict (orthogonal; MORE valuable run pre-T2 as baseline). #272 BUILD = the one strategic collision: increment (vi)'s flagship payoff (binary_search into the Lean auto tier) is superseded in T2 — §7B certifies binary_search at L4 via the stratified cage; stage 3 de-trusts Z3 via kernel RECONSTRUCTION, not parallel re-proof — recommend HOLD the build, keep the design as recorded alternative. Shipped work all carries forward: exporter (iv/v + #279/#281) is stage-1's 'forge front door' substrate; EngineAttribution seeds the §9 engine/trust block; mutation families enrich the catalogue re-elaboration mutation reuses; doc-drift discipline serves the correspondence-doc needs; lean_fragment audit report is a precursor of the routing-reason vocabulary. GAP the RFC surfaces that we independently hit at #265: NO Lean CI job (pre-M1 debt, real). Stale in the RFC's debt table: #148 already closed 06-08. Open question to put to the RFC thread: the LeanAuto exec-body second-engine path ((iv)/(v), --engine lean|auto, disagreement alarm) postdates the baseline and has no named place in T2 — needs an explicit slot or a deliberate sunset decision.
